title: Pure Tenyi
summary: Tenyi cards only, with generic staples; the page's Swordsoul end board is left out, and so is its Baronne de Fleur, which is Forbidden in the TCG. The Tenyi Spirits summon themselves while you control no Effect Monsters, and their real effects switch on once you control a non-Effect Monster. Monk of the Tenyi and Berserker of the Tenyi are Links without effects, so the deck makes its own. Ashuna then summons a Tenyi from the Deck, Vishuda bounces a card, and Adhara recovers a banished Wyrm. The 2025 cards lead. Tenyinfinity searches Vessel for the Dragon Cycle or Heavenly Dragon Circle, tributes a Wyrm to destroy a monster, and turns into Flawless Perfection of the Tenyi. Tenyi Spirit - Suruya is a Tuner that summons a Tenyi Link from the Extra Deck after a Wyrm Synchro. Tenyi Spirit - Mula Adhara searches a Field Spell and can't be targeted or destroyed while a non-Effect Monster is out.
